_doc: Real SELL transactions (getTransaction jsonParsed, commitment confirmed, research key, 2026-09-27) for review S27-01: each must still classify as a sale after the rent-refund and counterparty proofs. curve_sale_closing_ata: a pump curve sell of a Token-2022 coin that closes the seller's account (rent refunded). dflow_usdc_sale_fee_payer_not_owner: a registry owner (wileEcoyote) selling through DFlow into Manifest for USDC, fee paid by DFlow's relayer; the base and quote vaults have different PDA owners. routed_coin_usdc_sol: a registry owner (onmycheck) selling coin -> USDC (Raydium CLMM) -> SOL (PumpSwap) through the term9 router. Added 2026-09-28 (Beta, item 3, research key, flat book): dflow_sol_to_usdc_quote_leg: StonkyScheffler swapping native SOL for USDC through DFlow (-56.85 SOL, +6,736.76 USDC, no coin moved); J7 labels it a 'sell' of So111..., and it must NOT classify as a coin sale. dflow_coin_usdc_sale_second_signer: Roveryaps selling a whole coin balance for USDC through DFlow, the owner as the second signer; the watcher missed it only because it was relaunching (20:53:04Z / 20:55:04Z).
